reason: zod 3.x arrives only through the Privy 2 / WalletConnect / Reown wallet SDKs and runs in the visitor's browser, so the worst case is that visitor's own tab exhausting memory; no server parses untrusted input with it. decode-uri-component 0.2.x arrives only through query-string in the WalletConnect SDK and runs in the visitor's browser, so the worst case is a slow tab for that visitor.
